portal_description:
Releasing the new images after upgrading the base image version.

This release consists of the following parts:
* Fuse on OpenShift images (provided through the Red Hat container catalog)
* Fuse Online images (provided through the Red Hat container catalog)
* Maven dependencies (provided through the Red Hat Maven repository)

These images are intended for use with the following components:
* Red Hat Fuse version: 7.13.0.fuse-7_13_0-00012-redhat-00001
* Maven archetype version: 2.2.0.fuse-7_13_0-00014-redhat-00001

The base URL for the Fuse on OpenShift image streams and templates in this
release is:
https://github.com/jboss-fuse/application-templates/tree/application-templates-2.1.0.fuse-7_13_0-00014-redhat-00001

In this release, the Fuse on OpenShift images are distributed through the
registry.redhat.io image registry. This secure registry requires you to create
authentication credentials in your OpenShift cluster before you can install the
images.
For more details, see
https://access.redhat.com/documentation/en-us/red_hat_fuse/7.13/html/fuse_on_openshift_guide/get-started-admin#configuring-container-registry-authn_fuse-on-openshift.

To install the Fuse on OpenShift image streams, log in to OpenShift as an
administrator and enter the following command:

oc create -n openshift -f \
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jboss-fuse/application-templates/application-templates-2.1.0.fuse-7_13_0-00014-redhat-00001
/fis-image-streams.json

For details on how to install all of the Fuse on OpenShift components and
templates, see the Fuse on OpenShift Guide
(https://access.redhat.com/documentation/en-us/red_hat_fuse/7.13/html-single/fuse_on_openshift_guide/index).
